note: P is one poem four times: nacreous / mother-of-pearl light at dusk or dawn on cold air, with 'the sky holds' recurring in three of four. Q mixes two clouds (lens cloud over a ridge vs. high ice veil after sunset) and different angles (wind and snow smell, street at dusk, indoor cold cup on the sill, winter dusk), though the veil/pearl pair partly repeats.
